reviews.title: Love em
reviews.comment: I use these boards on almost every build I do now. I think I am up to my 10th. Easy, compatible, and I have only had one fault out and it was due to my friend shorting it out with a screw driver. So, really not a manufacturing issue at all. But, my friend bought another one and I switched everything over and boom up and running. Tons of USBs too. This board is for DDR4 ram and AMD

reviews.title: Dead motherboard
reviews.comment: Complete waste of time. I installed the motherboard it to turn on and not boot with a red cpu light on. Tested different cpu and parts. Lastly did a flash bios with same results. Wasted my morning.
reviews.author: Pansy

reviews.title: They delivered on what was promised....early.
reviews.comment: I was skeptical buying a refurbished motherboard, especially after having to return a new, but much lesser quality motherboard.  Everything they claimed was/is true.  The contents were all there, the board is in fantastic shape, and has been running good in my system for a week and a ½.  All of the voltage and temperature data that I can see from this board tells me I won't have any problems in the foreseeable future.  I feel like I got a sweet deal, on an MSI MAG Tomahawk B550 gaming motherboard,  and I did.  Thank you seller!  You completed me.
reviews.author: Sylas
